reason: My NRO money has sat there for years and I keep telling myself I'll sort it out on my next trip to India. It's under 5 lakh, so it never feels urgent enough to start paperwork this week.
objection: I don't know my tax position and the forms sound scary, so I'd rather put it off than hand my savings to a company I've just seen once in a scroll.
would_change_my_mind: A friend from my community group who already moved money with them and says it worked, plus a dead-simple way to start with a small amount without feeling committed.
